answer: Give every agent one iris-scanned identity: an orb maps your iris, hashes the template, and stores only the hash on-chain, so one living eye equals one account. First, the agent books a scan and pays a $40 fee. Second, the orb checks liveness and refuses photos or prints. Third, the hash joins a registry that rejects any duplicate iris. Fourth, flagged accounts face a fresh re-scan within 48 hours. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 10,000 real irises, $400,000 in fees, and 60 days of bookings. Like a karst garden where each plant whispers its own name, no two flowers share one root.
